gensokyolegacy/marisa/brewing/dialog/mar: Jackpot! Blaze rods and nether wart — now I can finally study this 'brewstand' business. You're the best research assistant a magician could ask for, ze!
Magic! That's the spirit! Thanks a bundle!
Got any blaze rods or wart yet? I'm itchin' to fire up a brewing stand!
Craft some fire resistance first! Don't be reckless.
Right on! Blaze rods and nether wart — the key ingredients!

Hold up! You mentioned *blazes* down there, right? And nether wart? The folks in this world figured out how to brew potions from scratch — a whole native potion system! Can ya imagine? I *gotta* understand it. I hear ya need a blaze rod to power a brewing stand, and nether wart to make the base. Bring me samples of both, and I'll reverse-engineer this 'Minecraft brewing' thing in no time!
So are goblins, and I've survived those bars for years! C'mon, a smart one like you can handle it!
gensokyolegacy/marisa/brewing/option/sta: Talk about the native potion system.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/brewing/quest/desc: Bring Marisa blaze rods and nether wart.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/chat/dialog/marisa: Yo! What can I do for ya?
gensokyolegacy/marisa/chat/greeting: Yo! Marisa Kirisame, the ordinary magician, at your service! Ze!
gensokyolegacy/marisa/chat/starter/start: Yo! Marisa Kirisame, the ordinary magician, at your service! Ze!
gensokyolegacy/marisa/chat/trade: Take a look! I've got some good stuff today, ze.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/daily_brewing/dial: Blaze rods and nether wart, remember? The brew's waitin' on 'em!
That's my buddy! Fetch me the brew bits!
Brewin' up a storm over here, and I'm fresh outta base ingredients! Skedaddle to the Nether and grab me some blaze rods and nether wart, willya? There's a good buddy!
Aw, don't leave me hangin'! The brew won't brew itself!
gensokyolegacy/marisa/daily_brewing/ques: Bring Marisa blaze rods and nether wart.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/daily_mycelium/dia: Oh, these are perfect! Thanks, buddy!
Stock's runnin' low again — the glowing ones, the dreamy ones, whatever ya can find. Remember?
That's the spirit! Bring me the good stuff!
Morning! My stock's runnin' low again. Bring me a fresh bundle of this world's specialty mushrooms — the glowing ones, the dreamy ones, whatever ya can find. Fresh research material, stat!
Aw, c'mon! The specialty mushrooms are the best part of this world's flora!
gensokyolegacy/marisa/daily_shroomlight/: Those glowing mushrooms and shroomlights from the Nether, remember? You're my scout!
That's my scout! Fetch me the glowy stuff!
Hey! I need more of those glowing mushrooms and shroomlights from the Nether. You're my personal Nether scout now, ze! Make a quick trip and bring 'em back.
What? The Nether's not that bad! Just watch out for the lava!
Bring Marisa shroomlights and nether fungus.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/daily_witchcraft/d: Just what I needed for the brew! Thanks!
Gettin' short on the gross stuff again — rotten flesh, spider eyes, miasma mushrooms. Remember?
Good, I'll have the brew ready!
Right on! Bring me the grubby bits!
Yo! I'm mid-brew and I'm runnin' short on the gross stuff. Think ya can scrounge up some rotten flesh, spider eyes, and a few of those miasma mushrooms? For, uh... research. Yeah. Research.
What, too good for a little research? C'mon, it'll be worth it!
gensokyolegacy/marisa/daily_witchcraft/q: Bring Marisa rotten flesh, spider eyes, and miasma mushrooms.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/first_mushroom/dia: Ohoho, these are perfect! Just the right moisture and bite. This'll jump-start my research something fierce!
Sure, no rush. Come back when you're ready.
Got 'em yet? I can practically taste the potion potential!
Take your time — just don't skimp on me, now!
That's the spirit, ze! Eight red or brown mushrooms'll do. Bring me the good stuff!

Ah, a newcomer! Marisa Kirisame, the ordinary magician, zo! This whole world's still fresh to me — even the grass smells different. Say, you live around here, right? I'm just getting my magic research started, and I need some honest-to-goodness samples. Bring me some red and brown mushrooms from the surface, would ya?
Aw, c'mon! Mushrooms are the foundation of every good potion recipe. You'd be doin' real science here!
gensokyolegacy/marisa/first_mushroom/opt: Ask if she got what she needed.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/first_mushroom/que: Bring Marisa red and brown mushrooms from the surface.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/golden_apple/dialo: THIS! This is a treasure! Look at that glow — that's *real* lost technology. I'm gonna take this apart, learn every secret, and build it myself. You just made a huge breakthrough possible!
Heh! With me around, ain't nothin' impossible!
Any sign of one of those glowy apples yet? Check dungeon chests — they like to hide in there!
Keep lookin'! It's gotta be out there somewhere. I just know it!
That's the Marisa-approved spirit! One enchanted golden apple, comin' right up!

One more thing, one more thing! Ever seen those fancy golden apples — the glowy ones, the 'enchanted' ones? The recipe's completely lost to this world. Nobody can craft 'em anymore. But *I* can figure it out! Bring me one as a prime sample, and I'll reverse-engineer the whole thing and share the knowledge. Whaddaya say?
Rare stuff is exactly the fun stuff! They're hidden in ruins and loot, so come back when you've sniffed one out.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/golden_apple/optio: Hand over the enchanted golden apple.
Talk about the lost golden apple tech.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/golden_apple/quest: Bring Marisa an enchanted golden apple.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/huge_mushroom/dial: THESE! These are exactly what I needed! Feel that density, ze? There's some serious magic packed in here!
You're a lifesaver! Now I've got dinner *and* research!
Got any of those big blocks yet? I wanna see how the cap connects to the stem!
Okay, okay — just don't bring me crumbs. I want the good stuff!
That's what I like to hear! Bring 'em intact — caps and stems, either kind is fine.

Whoa, hold on. Have ya seen the mushrooms around here? They're practically trees! I've never seen anything this huge — real whoppers. I tried pluckin' one, but it just shattered into little bits in my hands. There's gotta be a proper way to harvest the solid blocks. Think ya can bring me some whole giant mushroom blocks?
Tried it! They shatter into tiny caps — useless to me. I need 'em whole, stem and all. That's your specialty, right?
gensokyolegacy/marisa/nether_mushroom_pr: Oh man, look at this! You can practically feel the fire in it! The flora in this world adapts to *everything*. That's amazing research material, ze!
Science! You get it! Thanks a million!
Found any of that red Nether stuff yet? I hear it grows like a weed down there.
Hoglin trouble, huh? Just bring me what ya can!
Then I knew I could count on ya! Bring back the weird stuff!

Say — you've been to that creepy red world under the rock, right? The Nether, the fiery one? I hear the 'shrooms down there are somethin' else entirely. Never had the guts to go myself — all that heat and lava, yikes. But you've been there, haven't ya? Bring me some genuine Nether mushroom samples!
Heh, fair enough. But that's where the really good research material is! Come back when you're feelin' brave.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/shared/dialog/dail: Oh, you got 'em? Let me see!
gensokyolegacy/marisa/shared/option/dail: Could you go over the task again?
gensokyolegacy/marisa/shroomlight/dialog: Ohhh, these little lights are *beautiful*! And look at the structure inside this stem! The magic must practically flow through here. This is gonna make my potions glow like nobody's business!
Like 'em? I love 'em! You've got a real eye for research!
You gettin' any of that glowing stuff? I wanna see how it lights up!
Take care down there — don't get turned into a mushroom yourself!
Now we're talkin'! Shroomlights and fungus — as many as ya can carry!

Okay, okay! You mentioned those giant *fungus trees* in the Nether — whole towers of mushroom! And they glow, right? The shroomlights? I've gotta see one up close. I need some samples: a few of those light-up shroomlight blocks and a chunk of the tree itself. Best research material money can't buy!
Everything good is a little dangerous! Just grab a few blocks, then scoot. Easy!
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat/greeting: Hi! What brings you to the shrine?
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat/trade: I'd like to trade with you!
gensokyolegacy/reimu/daily_food/dialog/r: Just what the shrine needed. Thanks.
The donation box is empty again — bring a decent haul of supplies, remember.
Take your time. Just bring back something useful.
Good. Bring back a decent haul.
The donation box is empty again, and I'm hungry. Bring me a few things for the shrine.
A hungry miko is a distracted miko. Your call.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/daily_food/quest/de: Bring Reimu a few supplies for the shrine.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/daily_hunt/dialog/r: Something's been stirring near the shrine again — thin them out and bring back their loot, remember.
Stay careful out there. I need you in one piece.
That's the spirit. Go clear them out.
Something's been stirring up trouble near the shrine. Thin out the monsters and bring me some loot.
They'll only grow bolder. But it's your call.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/daily_hunt/quest/de: Thin out the monsters and bring Reimu some loot.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/daily_raid/dialog/r: The village is still standing. You're getting good at this.
The mark is fading. Ready for another round? I can set a fresh one.
There. Enter the village, hold the line, and drive them out. I'll be here after.
Here's the mark, same as before. Enter the village, hold the line, and drive them out.
A new mark is ready, and another village could use protecting. Ready for another raid?
The mark will keep. The raiders will still be there when you're ready.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/daily_raid/quest/de: Win a raid with Reimu's mark to protect a village.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/daily_talisman/dial: Good. The shelves are stocked again.
Talisman stock is low again — paper for folding, redstone for ink, remember.
The ofuda shelves are starting to look empty.
Great. Restock me and I'll keep the shrine warded.
Talisman stock is running low again. Paper and redstone, just like before.
No stock, no warding. Your call.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/daily_talisman/ques: Bring Reimu paper and redstone to restock her talismans.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/hostile_loot/dialog: You're back. Please tell me you didn't become one of them.
Perfect. Now I can compare these against the youkai I know. Thanks for the fieldwork.
No rush. Just don't let them nibble on you.
Got those samples yet? Flesh and bones should tell me plenty.
Good. Ten of each, plus rotten flesh and bones. Bring me enough samples to study.
The walking dead and clattering skeletons keep ambushing me. They're not exactly youkai, but I want to study them. Bring me some flesh and bones.
It is dangerous. But you've survived here longer than I have. You'll manage when you're ready.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/hostile_loot/quest/: Hunt zombies and skeletons for Reimu and collect their flesh and bones.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/local_food/dialog/r: Welcome back. Please tell me you brought food, not another donation.
Ahh, real food. Thanks. You're the first person I can count on here.
No rush. I'll just keep dreaming about mushroom stew.
I keep watching the villagers eat and feeling left out.
Great. Bread and mushroom stew. Nothing fancy, just enough to keep this shrine maiden fed.
I'm still figuring out what's safe to eat here. Bring me some bread and mushroom stew so I can learn the local food.
Foraging in an unfamiliar world wasn't in the shrine maiden handbook. But I suppose I'll manage.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/local_food/quest/de: Bring Reimu some bread and mushroom stew so she can learn this world's food.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/ominous_banner/dial: That's the one. Let me see what this strange banner is saying.
There it is. I'll study what binds these raiders together. Then we'll see what I can do about them.
Take your time. I'll be here.
Check outposts and patrols. That's where you're most likely to find one.
Good. Their captains carry those ominous banners. Take one down and bring it to me. Just watch for the mark they leave behind.
People keep whispering about *raiders*—armed groups with black-and-white banners. Bring me one from their captain. I want to know what it means.
They're still just humans with weapons. Come back when you're ready to deal with them.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/ominous_banner/ques: Bring Reimu an ominous banner from a raid captain.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/raid/dialog/reimu/r: The waves stopped? Good. So the plan worked.
You routed them. I knew baiting them into the village would work. Here—take my *Innate Dream* spellcard.
Not yet? Then stay sharp. They won't give up easily.
The village still stands, but the mark is fading. Care to go again? I can set a fresh one.
There. Walk into a village, draw them out, and drive every raider away.
There. The mark is on you. Walk into a village, draw them out, and drive every raider away.
I figured out the mark. My ofuda can recreate it. I'll put it on you; enter a village, draw the raiders in, and drive them out.
I've got shrine duties. You're the one who knows this world, so I'll leave the fighting to you.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/raid/option/complet: Tell Reimu the raid is over.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/raid/quest/desc: Enter a village carrying Reimu's mark and repel the raiders.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/shared/dialog/daily: Oh, you got 'em? Let me see!
gensokyolegacy/reimu/shared/option/daily: Could you go over the task again?
gensokyolegacy/reimu/talisman_materials/: You brought them. Let me see.
Excellent. I can make the new ofuda now. I'll make a few for you, too.
Okay, okay. The ofuda can wait a little longer.
I want to see how well the new ofuda work.
Good. Paper for folding, redstone for ink. That should keep the shrine stocked.
Paper here folds nicely, and this redstone dust glows with power. I can use it as vermilion ink for new-world ofuda. Bring me some.
It's red, it glows, and it's full of power. That's good enough for vermilion ink.
Bring Reimu paper and redstone for her new-world talismans.
